title: SceneWorks Model Manifest
description: Authoring schema for the model catalog. Constraint-shaped properties carry x-sceneworks-contract: binding means authoritative backend behavior (rejection unless the property's description explicitly names deterministic normalization), advisory means UI/selection guidance that is deliberately not a backend gate, and descriptive means factual metadata. tests/test_builtin_manifest_audit.py treats these annotations as the gated contract registry (sc-12304).

parameters.description: Default production parameters written to each Implemented/unverified matrix cell.

samplerKey.description: Sampler (integration method) advertised by shipped model backends. The unified gen-core names are joined by backend-specific ER-SDE and DPM++ 2M SDE values used by current catalog entries. "default" preserves the engine's native sampler.

schedulerKey.description: Sigma schedule advertised by shipped model backends. "default" preserves the engine's native schedule; shift and beta57 remain valid for current backend-specific catalog entries.

guidanceMethodKey.description: Classifier-free-guidance policy from the unified guidance axis (epic 7434). Names match gen-core's GuidanceMethod registry exactly. "cfg" is the standard guidance the engine applies by default (the N1 no-op); "cfg_rescale" (Lens-style std-rescale), "apg" (Bernini adaptive-projected guidance), and "cfg_pp" (CFG++, reparameterized low-cfg guidance) are advertised per-model-per-backend only where the linked engine descriptor honors them. The worker N3-falls an unadvertised method back to the engine default.

quantVariantKey.description: Download variant identifier. bf16/q8/q4 are standard quant-matrix tiers; int8-convrot is Krea's hosted ConvRot tier; training selects the dedicated Lens training artifact.

variantFootprint.description: Footprint metadata for one downloadable model variant (sc-8508). `diskSizeBytes` is required; measured memory is optional/nullable, but a non-null peak must declare the output-pixel geometry it was measured at so resolution-aware consumers can normalize it safely (sc-16020).

diskSizeBytes.description: On-disk size (bytes) of this variant's files after applying the download `files` filter. Required.

residentMemoryBytes.description: OPTIONAL measured steady-state resident memory (bytes) when this variant is loaded and generating. Null/absent until sc-8516 measures it.

peakMemoryBytes.description: OPTIONAL measured peak memory (bytes) during load + first generation. Null/absent until sc-8516 measures it.

measuredPixels.description: Output pixel count (width × height) used for residentMemoryBytes / peakMemoryBytes. Required whenever peakMemoryBytes is non-null; consumers must not assume a universal measurement resolution.

samplerLimits.description: Per-model sampler / scheduler / guidance capability lists used to gate Image / Video Studio dropdowns. Omit the keys entirely to disable the controls; include single-element ["default"] arrays for sealed adapters so the manifest is still self-describing.

phaseVramCurve.description: Conservative phase VRAM curve in GiB (legacy field suffix Gb): fixedGb + perMpxGb * output megapixels. NVIDIA budgets are sourced from nvidia-smi MiB and divided by 1024.

memoryEngagedComposition.description: Canonical ordered set of memory-strategy rungs engaged in the same request.

memoryStrategyRungSet.description: Exact canonical strategy-rung set engaged while the associated value was measured.

evidenceScope.description: Whether the cell carries geometry-specific output parity and may admit this exact runtime request, or carries only phase measurements for fitting the bounded curve.

loadability.description: Exact immutable artifact and canonical runtime route exercised by this evidence cell.

predictedPhasesGb.description: Exact phase-curve outputs for this evidence cell. Every emitted text/denoise/decode value must match these values within the declared 0.01 GiB tolerance.

observedPhasesGb.description: Direct rendered-device text/denoise/decode peaks. Required for phase_fit_only cells so a fitted coefficient is traceable to machine-readable same-tier measurements.

measuredCompositions.description: Per-rung composition active during the historical capture. Runtime compares this exact set with the current provider contract.

calibrationAbi.description: Memory-strategy calibration ABI consumed by the worker and supplied by the provider contract. A new ABI requires an explicit schema and worker migration, and re-measurement: each bump declares earlier records intentionally stale, so re-stamping a curve fitted under an older ABI is exactly the drift the handshake exists to reject (sc-17097).

loadShape.description: Typed materialization shape (calibration ABI 2) these curves were measured under. The worker compares it against the provider's own calibration identity: eager and deferred measurements are not interchangeable.

calibrationFingerprint.description: Stable provider/calibration identity. It must exactly match the provider contract before any optimized fit may be selected.

sceneWorksRevision.description: SceneWorks selector/calibration contract revision. The worker rejects evidence from any other revision.

inferenceRevision.description: Capture provenance only — the merged inference commit these curves were measured against. NEVER compared (sc-17774); see inferenceClosureDigest.

inferenceClosureDigest.description: Digest of candle-gen-krea's compile closure at inferenceRevision (sc-17774). Currency compares this against the live digest for candle:krea_2_turbo in config/inference-provider-closures.json. It replaces vram_gate.rs's frozen KREA_TURBO_INFERENCE_REVISION, which was one of several per-model mechanisms doing the same job differently.

provider.description: Closure lane id this block's digest belongs to, as the suffix of a `config/inference-provider-closures.json` key (`candle:` + this). sc-17989: scripts/backfill-closure-digests.mjs locates a binding by pairing this with inferenceRevision, so without it the digest is invisible to the CI verification gate and was maintained by hand.

measured.description: Krea Turbo fit curves are verified evidence only when measured on real hardware; estimated curves require a different unverified authoring contract.

verification.description: Human-auditable measurement, numerical-equivalence, and output-parity provenance for the calibrated envelope.

evidenceRecords.description: Immutable measured cells. exact_request records include geometry-specific output parity and may admit only that exact tier and geometry; phase_fit_only records characterize bounded curves but never authorize runtime selection.

resident.description: Resident execution has no optimization parameters.

threeStage.description: Staged residency uses provider lifecycle hooks and has no tunable parameter.

strategyParameters.description: Exact, cumulative provider parameters for each calibrated strategy. The worker validates these values against the provider contract before selection.

engagedCompositions.description: Current exact provider-contract composition for each rung. Historical evidence remains separately keyed by its measuredCompositions and binds only when the two sets match.

maxMeasuredPixels.description: Largest output pixel count covered by real rung measurements and output-parity validation. The worker must not extrapolate the constrained ladder beyond it.

phaseCurvesByTier.description: Measured phase curves by installed quant tier. Each tier must declare the complete quality-preserving ladder in increasing execution-cost order.

allOf.$comment: sc-13783: reconcile with scripts/check-scaffold.mjs (which enforces ui.promptGuide WITH a title/path on every PICKER entry). A promptGuide is a picker-only surface; type:"utility" provisioning/validation dependencies never appear in a Studio picker, so they are EXEMPT. The exempt set here MUST match apps/web/src/promptGuideContract.js PROMPT_GUIDE_EXEMPT_TYPES — promptGuideScaffoldSchemaContract.test.js fails if the two authorities diverge. The `then` requires title/path at the CONDITIONAL level (matching check-scaffold.mjs), not only via the unconditional #/properties/ui/promptGuide definition, so a picker can never satisfy the schema with an empty promptGuide that would still RED the scaffold.

precisionFloors.description: Worker-visible component precision substitutions. A provider may not hold a packable component above the selected tier unless the matching descriptor and tier-integrity row declare the same floor.

requiresLicenseAcknowledgment.description: Requires an explicit in-app license acknowledgment before the download is allowed (sc-17227). INDEPENDENT of `gated`: `gated` means the download needs a credential on `credentialHost`, this means the user must be shown the terms and accept them. `gated: true` also implies acknowledgment; this flag covers a PUBLIC repo whose license still binds the user (MiniMax-H3).

licenseNotice.description: Restrictions the user is notified of at the acknowledgment gate (sc-17227). Plain prose restating the upstream license's own operative terms — territory, acceptable use, revenue ceiling — not a summary invented here. Rendered inside the acknowledgment box.

defaults.description: Model defaults surfaced as form initial values in the studios. Sampler / scheduler defaults are read by the UI (the worker just honors whatever rides on advanced).

schedulerShift.description: Default shift value when scheduler == "shift". Typical range 1.0–6.0.

limits.description: Per-model constraints and capability menus. Each property is explicitly classified; never infer enforcement from the word limits.

resolutions.description: UI/recipe resolution menu. Runtime geometry is governed by the binding stride and pixel constraints.

count.x-sceneworks-reader-exemption: sc-12335 owns the deliberate limits.count UI-reader decision
count.description: Image Studio batch-size menu; deliberately not a backend rejection gate (sc-12335).

durations.description: UI duration menu. The binding hardMaxDuration ceiling owns backend rejection.

fps.description: Allowed render frame rates; API and worker reject off-menu requests.

hardMaxDuration.description: Hard clip-duration ceiling in seconds; API and worker reject rather than clamp.

hardMinDuration.description: Hard clip-duration FLOOR in seconds; API and worker reject rather than lengthen. The mirror of hardMaxDuration, and it exists because a family can have a floor its own engine refuses below rather than pads up to: MiniMax-H3's frame lattice is 17n+5 clamped to 124..=345 frames, so its shortest renderable clip is 124/24 = 5.1667 s and a 3 s request is REFUSED (sc-17158). ABSENT MEANS NO FLOOR, so every model that declares nothing is byte-for-byte unchanged — the same never-block-without-evidence posture hardMaxDuration takes.

steps.description: The EXACT set of denoise step counts this model can render; API and worker reject an off-menu request rather than snapping to the nearest legal count. The membership-tested sibling of hardMinSteps, and it exists because a distilled model's step count is not a knob at all: LTX-2.3 bakes its sigma waypoints into training and runs a fixed 8-step stage-1 schedule, so `hardMinSteps: 8` would say 'at least 8' and wrongly admit steps: 30, which the engine refuses (sc-19502). Enforced on the VIDEO enqueue path through the same steps_limit_error gate as hardMinSteps, which is why the two readers named here are the existing ones. Lane-agnostic on purpose: both backends derive the count from a byte-identical STAGE1_SIGMAS table and share gen-core's Capabilities::supported_steps floor, so one declaration binds both. ABSENT MEANS NO MENU, so every model that declares nothing is byte-for-byte unchanged. A declared menu must contain the model's own defaults.steps.

hardMinSteps.description: Hard FLOOR on `advanced.steps` (denoise / sampling steps); API and worker reject rather than raise the count. The sampling-axis sibling of hardMinDuration. THE UNIT IS MODEL EVALUATIONS (NFE) — the same unit `defaults.steps`, `advanced.steps` and a turbo adapter's `sampling.steps` carry: MiniMax-H3's engine builds its sigma grid as linspace(1, 0, steps + 1), appending the terminal 0 ITSELF (`JointSchedule::with_shifts(evaluations + 1, ..)`), so nothing in SceneWorks adds or subtracts one and `steps: 1` is a legal 2-point grid that RENDERS — as noise, because one evaluation is a single Euler jump from pure randomness. H3's floor of 2, the smallest schedule with an intermediate sigma, is therefore a PRODUCT judgement rather than an engine limit (sc-19426, corrected sc-18726); the retracted "N steps drive N-1 model evaluations, so 1 is unrenderable" reading described diffusers' `num_inference_steps` grid-point convention, which is NOT what this key counts. Enforced on the VIDEO enqueue path — the two gates named in x-sceneworks-readers are the only per-model rejection seams in the app, and the image lane has no counterpart. ABSENT MEANS NO FLOOR, so every model that declares nothing is byte-for-byte unchanged, the same never-block-without-evidence posture hardMinDuration takes. A declared floor must not exceed the model's own defaults.steps.

maxPixels.description: Maximum rendered pixel area; core fits requested geometry within this ceiling.

requiresDimensionsMultipleOf.description: Required render-dimension stride; core normalizes video geometry to this value, and Image Studio enforces it as the free Width/Height override stride for native-resolution image models (Mage-Flow).

recommendedMaxDuration.description: Non-blocking UI recommendation; intentionally not enforced.

maxReferenceAssets.description: Maximum still-image references (`referenceAssetIds`) this model conditions on; API and worker reject an over-cap request rather than dropping the extras. ABSENT MEANS 8, the ceiling every video family shipped before sc-17160 enforced, so an undeclared model is byte-for-byte unchanged. Declared only by a family whose real cap differs (MiniMax-H3 Ref2VA takes 9) — no builtin model needs it yet; sc-17158 is the first.

maxSourceClipAssets.description: Maximum source/reference video clips (`sourceClipAssetIds`) this model conditions on. ABSENT MEANS 8, the pre-sc-17160 ceiling. Declared by a family whose real cap differs (MiniMax-H3 Ref2VA takes 3) — no builtin model needs it yet; sc-17158 is the first.

maxReferenceAudioAssets.description: Maximum AUDIO references (`referenceAudioAssetIds`, sc-17160) this model conditions on. ABSENT MEANS 0 — unlike the two caps above, the default is a refusal, because the payload field is newer than every shipped video family and an engine handed conditioning it cannot consume renders unconditioned, which is invisible in the output. A model must declare that it takes audio references before one can reach it. No builtin model needs it yet; sc-17158 is the first.

maxCombinedReferenceAssets.description: Maximum reference FILES in total across `referenceAssetIds` + `sourceClipAssetIds` + `referenceAudioAssetIds` (sc-17160). NOT derivable from the three per-list caps — MiniMax-H3 Ref2VA takes 9 + 3 + 3 per list but only 12 files together — which is why it is its own key: it is the only cap that can refuse a request in which every individual list fits. ABSENT MEANS NO COMBINED CEILING, so an undeclared model is unchanged. No builtin model needs it yet; sc-17158 is the first.

guidanceMethods.description: Supported backend-neutral guidance menu shape; no builtin model currently needs it.

ui.description: Display metadata for model catalog and studio surfaces.

attribution.description: Attribution line the upstream license REQUIRES on the user interface (sc-17227) — e.g. MiniMax H3 Community License §IV.2 "You shall prominently display 'MiniMax H3' on the user interface". Rendered prominently above the description on the model card, not folded into prose.

promptGuide.description: Static Markdown prompt guide shown near prompt entry for this model.

path.description: Web-public Markdown path, served from apps/web/public.

sources.description: Primary or supplemental source links used to write the guide.

mlx.description: macOS/Apple-Silicon MLX variant metadata (desktop only). Surfaced by the Model Manager to show MLX availability, conversion status, and the minimum unified-memory tier. Inference repos/paths are owned by the Python MlxVideoAdapter; these mirror them for catalog display.

convertBaseSubdir.description: Quant-tier subdir under convertBaseRepo's snapshot whose (dense, tier-invariant) VAE/text-encoder/tokenizer the converter borrows — e.g. "bf16" for the FLUX.2-klein turnkey, whose components live under <tier>/ rather than the snapshot root. The worker prefers this tier and falls back to any installed tier. Omit when convertBaseRepo is a plain root-layout diffusers snapshot.

minMemoryGb.description: Minimum unified memory (GB) to run this model on MLX. Mirrors MlxVideoAdapter.estimate_requirements peak_gb.

measuredSiblingActiveDiskFraction.description: Opt in only when every selectable MLX quant tier preserves the same load topology. This is the fraction of precision-dependent disk growth active at once (for example 0.5 when one of two equal experts is resident). The web estimator anchors an unmeasured tier at a smaller compatible sibling's measured peak and scales only the disk delta by this fraction. Absence keeps the calibrated dense fallback; a shared model id alone is not compatibility evidence.

inferenceClosureDigest.description: Digest of THIS PROVIDER'S inference compile closure at inferenceRevision (sc-17774). Currency compares it against the live digest for the same provider in config/inference-provider-closures.json, so a change to another model's code path can no longer demote this calibration. inferenceRevision remains capture provenance and is never compared. Derivation and known gaps: scripts/inference-closure-digest.mjs.

engagedRungs.description: Rungs the measured request actually engaged, matching the receipt's strategy.engagedRungs. Omitted means the shared cost-order default. Declaring it is how a provider that implements rung 4 with rungs 2 and 3 Missing binds evidence for the cheaper composition it verified (sc-17728).

parameters.description: Exact closed strategy parameters used to select one evidence-contract cell; the Rust reader enforces the required and forbidden keys of the ENGAGED composition, not of the selected rung's ordinal.

calibrations.description: Optional exact per-cell MLX calibration bindings. Multiple tiers and request cells are allowed; absence deliberately keeps legacy admission, while duplicate selectors and malformed opt-ins fail closed.

supportsSequentialOffload.description: Static provider capability: the registered MLX generator can defer and release model components during request execution. Exact per-rung availability remains declared by memoryStrategyContract and runtime evidence.

exhaustive.description: When true, implementations is the provider's complete memory-strategy inventory. Any coordinate or rung not matched by an implementation remains Missing instead of inheriting generic engine-route Resident or staged-residency claims.

memoryStrategyContract.description: Pinned provider capability declaration for static matrix inventory. It cannot mark a cell Verified; exact promoted runtime evidence remains owned by mlx.calibrations. An exhaustive declaration also prevents generic route fallbacks from widening the provider's declared capability surface.

repo.description: Turnkey MLX repo downloaded as-is (no conversion). Omitted when requiresConversion is true.

requiresConversion.description: When true, the native checkpoint must be converted to MLX locally via a tracked model_convert job.

standardTierLayout.description: When true, this model ships the standard SceneWorks quant-matrix turnkey layout (sc-8508): self-contained q4/ + q8/ + bf16/ subdirs under one repo, each a complete from_snapshot tree. The worker routes weight resolution through standard_tier_subdir on this flag (the manifest-driven generalization of the hardcoded STANDARD_TIER_MODELS registry). Additive — a model already in the registry keeps working without it.

denseTextEncoderTier.description: When true (with standardTierLayout), every tier keeps a DENSE bf16 text encoder — only the transformer is packed (e.g. FLUX.2-klein). The worker forces the load quant to None for these so the dense TE is never re-quantized. THIS IS A DECLARED ABOVE-TIER RESIDENCY EXCEPTION (sc-15799): on a q4 or q8 tier the text encoder is resident at a HIGHER precision than the user selected, which the tier-integrity invariant permits only when the exception is declared and measured. Since sc-15799 this flag is the ONLY way to obtain the carve-out — the hardcoded DENSE_TE_TIER_MODELS worker registry it used to mirror is deleted, because an exception the shared decision cannot see is exactly what that story removes. Setting it REQUIRES a matching exception row in config/tier-integrity.jsonc; scripts/check-tier-integrity.mjs fails the parity lane otherwise.

convertSourceRepo.description: Native checkpoint repo used as the conversion source when requiresConversion is true.

limits.description: Per-backend capability override (epic 1753). MLX-backed Wan/LTX adapters expose only ["default"]; the top-level limits.samplers/schedulers describe the torch path.

candle.description: candle/CUDA (Windows/Linux) variant metadata — the discrete-VRAM sibling of the mlx block (epic 9083, sc-9094). CUDA cards do NOT share system RAM the way Apple unified memory does, so the candle lane needs its OWN measured VRAM gate: the mlx.minMemoryGb (unified-memory OS peak on a Mac) does not describe the VRAM a discrete GPU must hold.

minMemoryGb.description: Minimum GPU VRAM (GB) to run this model on the candle/CUDA lane — the measured overall-peak of the DEFAULT (lightest, typically q4) hosted tier, plus headroom. This gates the default tier only, matching the established MLX default-tier-gating convention; heavier hosted tiers (q8 / bf16) can exceed this value, and their per-tier measured ceilings live in vramGbByTier. Retires the epic 7982 SD3.5 'minMemoryGb under measured peak' follow-up: this is a real measured CUDA number, not the inherited unified-memory mlx value.

vramGbByTier.description: Calibrated, explicitly estimated, or conservative uncalibrated candle/CUDA overall-peak VRAM (GB), keyed by quant tier (q4 / q8 / bf16); the sibling measured flag distinguishes those evidence classes. Its output geometry is declared by vramMeasuredPixels. The peak is the max across the whole generate (load + denoise + VAE decode); candle loads weights lazily on first forward, so load-peak is negligible and the denoise peak dominates (sc-9094). This is the RESIDENT peak (all components co-resident) that the fit-gate compares against free VRAM to pick sequential offload vs reject.

vramMeasuredPixels.description: Output pixel count (width × height) used for vramGbByTier. Required with that ladder so resolution-aware consumers can normalize each tier without assuming the probe geometry.

sequentialPeakGb.description: Candle/CUDA SEQUENTIAL-residency peak or conservative high-water VRAM (GB) at the vramMeasuredPixels geometry, keyed by quant tier — the largest single working set when the provider loads→uses→drops each component in phase order (text encoders dropped before the DiT). The sibling measured flag says whether it is calibrated evidence. Always ≤ the resident vramGbByTier. Present only for sequential-capable providers (the candle FLUX lane, epic 10765 sc-10769). The fit-gate consults it as the SECOND-stage check (sc-10856): when the resident peak forces sequential offload but this peak still exceeds free VRAM, reject before load instead of running into a reactive OOM. Absent this number the gate keeps its best-effort behavior (run sequentially, reactive-OOM backstop).

supportsSequentialOffload.description: Static provider capability: the registered Candle generator honors LoadSpec sequential residency. Separate from sequentialPeakGb, which records measurement evidence.

memoryStrategyCapabilities.description: Static, unmeasured provider capability declarations. Measurement and promotion remain in calibration evidence; these rows only prevent implemented rungs from being rendered as Missing.

memoryStrategyStructuralExemptions.description: Static architecture evidence for rungs that cannot apply to this provider. These declarations produce Structurally N/A matrix cells and never enable a runtime strategy.

calibrations.description: Optional exact per-cell Candle/CUDA calibration bindings. The worker submits only exact authoritative packaged records to the shared selector; absence or any identity mismatch leaves optimized execution unavailable.

memoryStrategyContract.description: Pinned Candle/CUDA provider capability declaration for static matrix inventory. Exact promoted runtime evidence remains owned by candle.calibrations.

turboFit.description: Resolution-aware, per-phase constrained-card fit evidence for ordinary Krea 2 Turbo. The worker selects the least-cost sufficient rung and fails closed to the established resident/sequential gate when a tier has no complete measured curves.

measured.description: true only when minMemoryGb / vramGbByTier are calibrated measurements at the declared workload geometry and may be consumed as measured evidence; false when ESTIMATED (scaled from weight size + a measured sibling) or when a conservative real-GPU high-water was captured at a functional-minimum geometry rather than the catalog calibration workload. An unmeasured entry remains a fail-closed tier gate and is tracked for a full calibration.

control.description: Pose-ControlNet lane VRAM fit ladder numbers (sc-11754, epic 8459 → epic 10765), keyed by BASE quant tier. Present only for a model with a bespoke trained control branch (Krea 2 Turbo). The control lane loads the base at the installed tier PLUS the control branch, so its render peak exceeds the txt2img vramGbByTier and needs its own numbers; the worker's krea_control_fit gate reads these vs live/capped free VRAM and engages the cheapest sufficient rung only when constrained. sc-15799 (tier integrity) removed the branch-quant rung: the branch's tier is a function of the BASE tier (branchTierByBaseTier), so there is nothing left for the ladder to trade. Current peak rows are measured against that shipping branch tier and are read verbatim with no derived branch correction.

inferenceClosureDigest.description: Digest of candle-gen-krea's compile closure when these direct control-lane measurements were taken (sc-17774). Currency compares it against the live digest for candle:krea_2_turbo_control. It replaces krea_control_fit.rs's frozen KREA_CONTROL_INFERENCE_REVISION — which that module also stamped onto its own evidence, so the shared staleness check compared a constant against itself and could never fire.

inferenceRevision.description: Capture provenance for inferenceClosureDigest: the inference revision these control-lane measurements were taken at. NOT the compared term — currency is the digest above. sc-17989 promoted it from a prose comment so scripts/backfill-closure-digests.mjs can pair it with `provider` below, re-derive the digest from real source at this revision, and fail CI on a disagreement. Before it, this digest was maintained by hand and graded by nothing.

provider.description: Closure lane id this block's digest belongs to, as the suffix of a `config/inference-provider-closures.json` key (`candle:` + this). sc-17989: the stamper locates a binding by pairing this with inferenceRevision, so without it the digest is invisible to the CI verification gate.

branchTierByBaseTier.description: TIER INTEGRITY (sc-15799): the tier the pose control branch is packed to, keyed by BASE quant tier. Declarative mirror of gen_core::tier_integrity::control_branch_tier, which is the executable rule — this records what ships so the audit table and the parity lane can see it. q8 and int8-convrot use q8; q4 floors its branch to q8 because q4 residuals caused measured non-pose drift; bf16 uses bf16. NOT budget-dependent and NOT a memory lever. Every tier the entry HOSTS must appear as a key, enforced by scripts/check-tier-integrity.mjs.

peakGbByTier.description: Measured overall control-lane render peak VRAM (GB) at 1024²/8-step, keyed by BASE quant tier, with the shipping branch tier from branchTierByBaseTier and no fit-ladder rungs engaged. The worker reads each row verbatim and adds only the standard admission headroom; it applies no derived branch correction.

sequentialPeakGbByTier.description: Measured pose-control peak after the provider encodes and drops Qwen3-VL before loading the DiT + shipping control branch + VAE (sc-12176), keyed by BASE quant tier. This is the cheapest fit-ladder rung and the second-stage reject ceiling; deeper tiling/chunking savings compose from this staged baseline. Read verbatim exactly like peakGbByTier.

decodeTileSaveGb.description: Measured peak reduction (GB) from the CHEAPEST deeper rung — forcing the seam-free tiled VAE decode (sc-11744, candle-gen #492; Krea2ControlRequest.tile_vae_decode), keyed by BASE quant tier. A SPEED cost, no quality cost. Measured only for the tier(s) where the end-of-render decode spike IS the render peak (q4); omitted where the denoise steady-state dominates and tiling recovers little. Carried across the sc-15799 repack: it is a delta between two arms of the same load, so the resident branch is present in both and cancels.

chunkAttnSaveGb.description: Measured peak reduction (GB) from the DEEPEST rung — engaging sc-6217-style query-row attention chunking on the composable base stack + control branch (sc-11745, candle-gen #496; Krea2ControlPaths.chunk_attention). A SPEED cost, no quality cost (the chunked forward is byte-identical). Bounds the DENOISE-phase activation peak. A SCALAR (not tier-keyed): the activation peak is bf16 regardless of the base weight tier, which is also why the sc-15799 branch repack does not move it.

measured.description: true when peakGbByTier / sequentialPeakGbByTier / decodeTileSaveGb / chunkAttnSaveGb were measured on a real GPU for the configuration that ships; false when superseded or partially estimated pending measurement. This is read, not decorative: krea_control_fit::control_evidence_is_current permits hard reject and reclaimable high-water accounting only for current evidence.

supersededBy.description: Shortcut story id whose change invalidated the measurements in this block, present only while `measured` is false. Its presence is the machine-readable form of 'do not read these rows as current calibrated evidence'.

limits.description: Per-backend candle/CUDA capability override, read by samplerOptionsFromModel(model, "candle"). The top-level limits.samplers/schedulers describe the default lane; this narrows/broadens them for the candle path.

image.description: Image-generation capability metadata (sc-15299) — the image-lane sibling of the `video` sub-block (sc-8445), declaring which generation AXES an image engine actually has so Image Studio can hide a control the worker would discard rather than offering a knob that silently does nothing. Mirrors the engine descriptor's own `Capabilities { supports_guidance, supports_negative_prompt }`, which `resolve_guidance` / `resolve_negative_prompt` in the worker's image_jobs/base.rs already gate on. Every property is OPTIONAL and, exactly like `video` but UNLIKE `audio`, an ABSENT property means TRUE: the image population is overwhelmingly guidance-taking, so absent-means-supported is the correct default and leaves an undeclared entry behaving exactly as it did before this block existed. Only a guidance-distilled engine that genuinely lacks an axis declares it false.

supportsGuidance.description: Does the engine have a classifier-free-guidance axis? False for a guidance-distilled engine whose descriptor advertises `supports_guidance: false`, so the worker's `resolve_guidance` returns None and never forwards a scale. ABSENT MEANS TRUE. When false, Image Studio hides its Guidance control and stops emitting `advanced.guidanceScale`.

supportsNegativePrompt.description: Does the engine accept a negative prompt? An engine with no steerable unconditional branch has nothing for a negative prompt to do — `resolve_negative_prompt` returns None for any model whose descriptor advertises `supports_negative_prompt: false`. ABSENT MEANS TRUE. When false, Image Studio hides its Negative prompt field, never seeds `ui.defaultNegativePrompt` into it, and sends an empty one.

video.description: Video-generation capability metadata (sc-8445, epic 8431) — the video-lane sibling of the `audio` sub-block, declaring which generation AXES a video engine actually has so Video Studio can hide a control the worker would discard rather than offering a knob that silently does nothing. Every property is OPTIONAL and, unlike `audio`, an ABSENT property means TRUE: the video population is majority guidance-taking — eight of the ten shipped video entries (the Wan family, both LTX entries, SCAIL-2, Bernini) read a CFG scale and a negative prompt and declare nothing — so absent-means-supported is the correct default for them and leaves an undeclared entry behaving exactly as it did before this block existed. The two that genuinely lack the axes declare them false: `krea_realtime_14b` (Self-Forcing distilled it out) and `svd` (its engine drives its own frame-wise CFG ramp).

supportsGuidance.description: Does the engine have a classifier-free-guidance axis? False when the engine exposes no guidance scale at all: krea_realtime_14b's Self-Forcing distillation baked guidance out (a single batch-1 forward), and svd drives its own frame-wise CFG ramp — `generate_svd` hard-sets `guidance: None`. ABSENT MEANS TRUE. When false, Video Studio hides its Guidance control and stops emitting `advanced.guidanceScale`.

supportsNegativePrompt.description: Does the engine accept a negative prompt? An engine with no steerable unconditional branch has nothing for a negative prompt to do — both `generate_krea_realtime` and `generate_svd` hard-set `negative_prompt: None`. ABSENT MEANS TRUE. When false, Video Studio hides its Negative prompt field and sends an empty one.

audio.description: Audio-generation capability metadata (epic 13400, sc-13401) — a per-entry sibling of the mlx/candle backend blocks. It advertises what an audio model (Audio Studio's Speech / Music / SFX / VoiceClone tabs) supports so the studio can build its pickers and mode gates without probing the backend. Populated from the backend Capabilities (epic 12833). Chosen as a dedicated sub-block rather than limits/defaults because those are resolution-shaped and additionalProperties:false, so they would reject audio-shaped fields. Every property is OPTIONAL: a model advertises only the surfaces it actually supports (a bare Speech model may declare only voices/languages, while a full VoiceClone model adds editModes/conditioning).

voices.description: Selectable speaker voices, as objects so the Audio Studio picker can group by gender / accent / language. Only `id` is required; the optional fields drive grouping and display. Omit entirely for models with no fixed voice set (e.g. a music or SFX model, or a clone-from-reference model).

id.description: Backend voice identifier passed through to the generate job.

label.description: Human-readable picker label. Falls back to `id` when absent.

gender.description: Advisory grouping key for the picker (e.g. "female", "male", "neutral"). Free-form; not a backend gate.

accent.description: Advisory grouping key for the picker (e.g. "american", "british"). Free-form; not a backend gate.

language.description: Primary language tag this voice speaks (e.g. "en-US"). Advisory grouping key; a subset of the model-level `languages` list.

languages.description: Supported language / locale tags (e.g. "en-US", "en-GB"). Advisory menu the Audio Studio surfaces; the backend owns actual synthesis support.

sampleRates.description: Output sample rates in Hz the model can render (e.g. 24000, 48000). Advisory picker menu.

maxDurationSecs.description: Longest clip (seconds) the model can generate in one request. Advisory UI ceiling; backend enforcement is owned by the audio adapter.

editModes.description: Supported audio edit operations (e.g. "extend", "inpaint", "cover"). Present only for models with an editing surface; absent for pure text-to-audio models.

supportsMultiSpeaker.description: Whether the model can render a multi-speaker turn/dialogue in a single request (backend Capabilities.supports_multi_speaker, sc-12848). When true the Audio Studio reveals a segmented-script editor and submits an AudioParams.script; a script sent to a model that does NOT advertise this is rejected as a typed Unsupported at the gen-core floor. Absent/false means single-speaker only.

maxSpeakers.description: The most distinct speakers a multi-speaker model renders in one request (backend Capabilities.max_speakers, sc-12848). Consulted only when supportsMultiSpeaker is true — the Audio Studio's segmented-script editor offers at most this many speaker labels, and the gen-core floor rejects a script naming more. Absent means no advertised cap.

supportsStreaming.description: Whether the model streams audio incrementally as it renders (backend Capabilities.supports_streaming, sc-12846). When true the worker drives Generator::generate_streaming so partial PCM chunks arrive before the clip finishes, and the Audio Studio reveals progressive/streaming results in the results zone. Absent/false means one-shot synthesis. The reassembly of every chunk still equals the one-shot track, so it is advisory to the STREAM SHAPE, not to correctness (sc-13675).

supportsGuidance.description: Whether the model has a classifier-free-guidance axis (backend Capabilities.supports_guidance). Read by Audio Studio's Music tab to decide whether to render its Guidance (CFG) control; a scale sent to a model that does not advertise it is rejected as a typed Unsupported at the gen-core floor. ⚠️ Polarity here is the AUDIO one — ABSENT MEANS FALSE, the opposite of the `image` / `video` blocks — because the audio population is the reverse shape: the only music engine shipped is guidance-distilled. Declared in the schema by sc-15299; the Audio Studio read predates it, so before that fix the key could not be set at all (this object is additionalProperties:false) and the control was permanently hidden by accident rather than by declaration.

supportsNegativePrompt.description: Whether the model accepts a negative prompt (backend Capabilities.supports_negative_prompt). Read by Audio Studio's Music tab for its Negative prompt field. ABSENT MEANS FALSE — same audio polarity and the same sc-15299 history as `supportsGuidance`.

conditioning.description: Extra conditioning inputs the model accepts (e.g. "AudioEdit", "ReferenceAudio", "VoiceEmbedding"). Drives which reference/upload controls the Audio Studio exposes.

downloads.description: Download entries are usually PICK-ONE alternates for the same model: at most one applicable non-co-requisite may be marked default: true per OS (else the first supported entry is used). tests/test_builtin_manifest_audit.py enforces that platform-aware invariant because JSON Schema cannot compare overlapping platform sets. A quant matrix (epic 8506, sc-8508) lists each tier as a separate same-repo entry distinguished by files/variant; OS alternates are distinguished by platforms. Entries flagged coRequisite: true are FETCH-ALL dependencies installed alongside the primary. Hard co-requisites (the default) gate install state; soft co-requisites preserve usability and surface an available update (sc-9696, sc-13079).

allOf.$comment: sc-14980: a subdir narrows WHICH directory of a coRequisite's snapshot is staged for its componentId, so like componentId it is valid ONLY on coRequisite: true entries.

sc-13771: a componentId names a component PROVISIONED by a coRequisite download, so it is valid ONLY on coRequisite: true entries — a manifest-local invariant that JSON Schema CAN enforce without inference-descriptor knowledge (contrast the componentId ⟺ some descriptor.required_components match, which the manifest audit cannot see and stays a runtime resolve_co_requisites check).

provider.description: Download provider identifier, such as huggingface.

repo.description: Provider repository or model identifier used when queueing a download.

revision.description: Optional pinned 40-hex git commit SHA — the F-029 pin authority for this download (sc-13659). When present the download job forwards it so the worker fetches that exact IMMUTABLE commit into snapshots/<sha>/; absent means the worker resolves `main` at install time, so the ~200 existing non-pinned models need no migration. MUST be a full 40-char lowercase-hex commit: a branch/tag/short SHA is rejected by the pattern above because it resolves online but hard-fails the offline pinned-SHA resolver (hf_get_pinned reads snapshots/<sha>/). REQUIRED on coRequisite: true entries — the F-029 guarantee that a companion weight (e.g. chatterbox_tts's ve/perth) installs to a deterministic, offline-resolvable snapshot; that conditional is enforced by tests/test_builtin_manifest_audit.py and crates/sceneworks-core/src/builtin_manifests.rs rather than JSON Schema, which cannot grandfather the sc-13591 pin migration still in flight. See sc-13541, sc-13591.

componentId.description: Optional stable component id this coRequisite download PROVISIONS for the model's engine (epic 13657, sc-13679). When set (valid ONLY on `coRequisite: true` entries — schema-enforced by the allOf conditional above, sc-13771), the worker stages the resolved local path under this id in the engine's `LoadSpec::components`, matched against the provider's `ModelDescriptor::required_components` advertisement — the explicit repo→component mapping (never inferred from repo names) that the generic `resolve_co_requisites` seam reads. Lowercase snake_case, same shape as a descriptor id. Examples: chatterbox_tts's ve/perth co-requisites carry `voice_embedding`/`perth`; SDXL's carry `tokenizer_clip_l`/`tokenizer_clip_bigg`/`vae_fp16_fix` (sc-13682). Absent on a co-requisite the engine does not read as a named component (e.g. the PiD-gemma / Wan-Lightning shared weights).

subdir.description: Optional path, relative to this coRequisite's cached snapshot, of the directory actually staged for `componentId` (sc-14980). Valid ONLY on `coRequisite: true` entries — schema-enforced by the allOf conditional above. Without it a multi-file co-requisite stages the WHOLE snapshot, which cannot express a shared mirror hosting SEVERAL components at SEVERAL quant tiers: Mage-Flow's `SceneWorks/Mage-Flow-Components-mlx` holds `<tier>/text_encoder/` and `<tier>/vae/`, so each row sets `subdir` to the exact component dir (e.g. `q4/text_encoder`) while `files` keeps listing the snapshot-relative patterns the downloader fetches. Confined under the snapshot with safe_join at resolve time, so a `..`/absolute value is rejected rather than staged.

default.description: Marks the canonical alternate used for displayed size, install path, and download jobs. For a quant matrix this marks the DEFAULT tier (the one that installs when no explicit variant is requested).

variant.description: The quantization tier this entry provisions (bf16 / q8 / q4). Present only on quant-matrix entries (sc-8508); a single-variant model omits it. The web/download-job selects a tier by this key, and per-variant install tracking reports which tiers are on disk. On a NON-coRequisite entry this is the selectable tier. On a `coRequisite: true` entry (sc-14980) it instead SCOPES that co-requisite to one tier: Mage-Flow's shared text encoder and VAE exist as q4/q8/bf16 subtrees of a single components mirror, so only the row matching the selected tier is fetched, sized, and gated on, and `resolve_co_requisites_for_tier` picks among same-`componentId` rows by it. A co-requisite WITHOUT a variant is tier-agnostic and always applies — every pre-sc-14980 co-requisite.

coRequisite.description: Marks this entry as a FETCH-ALL dependency installed IN ADDITION TO the primary download, not a pick-one alternate (contrast `variant` tiers and `platforms` OS alternates). Installing the model queues the primary plus every co-requisite for the current OS. A hard dependency (the default) gates install state; a soft dependency leaves the primary usable and surfaces updateAvailable. Co-requisites are never chosen as the primary/default and are excluded from quant-tier enumeration. A co-requisite may be shared by several models, so deleting one model does NOT remove it. See sc-9696, sc-13079, epic 7840.

required.description: Co-requisite enforcement policy. hard (the default) gates usability when the dependency is absent or stale; soft keeps an otherwise usable install available while surfacing updateAvailable. Only valid with coRequisite: true.

breaking.description: Whether replacing an older receipt-backed install is mandatory. When true, stale files are not considered usable; omitted/false preserves the installed model and surfaces updateAvailable.

estimatedSizeBytes.description: Estimated bytes for the actual files downloaded after applying the files filter. Refresh from the provider when upstream files change.

footprint.description: Per-variant footprint metadata (sc-8508): required on-disk size plus OPTIONAL measured resident/peak memory (populated later by sc-8516). Distinct from estimatedSizeBytes so the RAM-suggestion surfaces (sc-8509/8516) have a stable, tier-scoped signal.

files.description: Optional allow-list of provider file patterns included in the download.

breaking.description: Model-wide default for whether a stale receipt-backed download is unusable. Individual download entries may opt in independently; omitted/false is non-breaking.

resources.description: Named auxiliary files required by an adapter or optional post-process. Resource entries are resolved by repo/file and should be lazy-fetched only when the feature that needs them runs.

captionStyle.description: Reference-image → prompt describe style (epic 8203). 'prose' (default when absent) emits a natural-language description; 'tags' emits a comma-separated booru/danbooru tag list for anime/booru SDXL checkpoints. The web forwards this to the image_describe job. Ignored by structuredPrompt models (Ideogram), which use the JSON caption path instead.
